agent_execution_scope: starts after setup/reset and gold-state materialization completes; ends before local evaluation or semantic judge
step_limit_definition: Core-200-compatible recorded trajectory step events, including invalid/failed interactions and the final done turn
actual_environment_steps_definition: the same count used by the Core-200 main runner result.steps: every recorded trajectory event with event=step, including invalid/failed interactions and the final done interaction
termination_policy: stop normally when the agent emits done
stop the agent loop at 30 recorded interaction turns
stop the agent loop at 600 seconds of post-reset agent interaction execution
reset, setup, gold-state materialization, local evaluation, semantic judging, and cleanup are excluded from the 600 seconds
an infrastructure-phase failure is recorded separately and does not become an agent FAIL
a semantic-judge timeout or exhausted retry yields UNCERTAIN and mandatory human audit
the outer process safety timeout only prevents a stuck lifecycle and is not the agent-duration metric

aggregation.local_all: all isolated stages for the original task pass after UNCERTAIN adjudication
aggregation.e2e: version-matched E2E success on the same Final-60 task
aggregation.composition_gap: Local-All success rate minus E2E success rate
aggregation.budget_feasible_robustness: optional: recompute Local-All on tasks whose isolated-stage actual-step sum is within the declared comparison threshold; report the threshold explicitly
